# Lab 16.1: Enable Gemini in BigQuery & Tour Agents

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn on Gemini in BigQuery and the Conversational Analytics API, grant the roles, and explore the Agents page.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Enable the APIs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable cloudaicompanion.googleapis.com geminidataanalytics.googleapis.com aiplatform.googleapis.com
bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab16</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Grant yourself the roles.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ME="user:$(gcloud config get-value account)"
for ROLE in roles/cloudaicompanion.user roles/geminidataanalytics.dataAgentCreator roles/bigquery.user; do
  gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member="$ME" --role=$ROLE --quiet
done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Business users who only chat with published agents need `roles/geminidataanalytics.dataAgentUser` and read access to the data.

3. **[Console] Check where data is processed.** Open the Gemini settings in BigQuery and read **Where Gemini in BigQuery processes your data**. Admins can restrict processing to specific regions.

4. **[Console] Tour the Agents page.** Click **Agents** in the BigQuery menu. Look at:
   - **Conversational analytics**: chat with tables, graphs and Lakehouse data.
   - **Data agents**: your saved agents (draft and published).
   - Links to the **Data Engineering Agent** (Dataform/pipelines) and **Data Science Agent** (notebooks).

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| APIs | Gemini for Cloud, Conversational Analytics, Vertex AI |
| Creator role | `dataAgentCreator` |
| User role | `dataAgentUser` |
| Agents page | One place for BigQuery's agents |
